contracts.title: Eight-Area Modular Source Topology
contracts.purpose: Keeps all authored module-system areas, their generated counterparts, and their explicit ordering evidence visible before a build or game launch.

rules.label: All eight modular source areas are indexed
Canonical project build entry point exists

nativeProof.detail: Run the reviewed module build and perform the targeted in-game smoke path; structural evidence does not prove engine runtime state.

contracts.title: Direct Module Reference Integrity
contracts.purpose: Prevents duplicate authored definitions, direct dangling script/menu/mission/presentation/quest references, and parse failures from becoming a launch-only surprise.

nativeProof.detail: This validates direct static names only. Dynamic selectors, branch reachability, and M&B engine behavior require target-specific source review and in-game proof.

contracts.title: Visible Text Flow Observability
contracts.purpose: Keeps source-to-generated text provenance and the string/register preflight available so wrong-screen text is diagnosed before launch.

rules.label: Generated module source markers are available
At least one visible text sink maps back to source

nativeProof.detail: Use text_explain/register_history and then verify the exact menu, dialogue, presentation, or message path in game after an intentional build.

contracts.title: Semantic Authoring Gate
contracts.purpose: Makes the Atlas, Dialogue Composer, Presentation Layout Composer, and Change Router regression surface explicit before semantic editing is relied upon.

nativeProof.detail: These are DevKit safety contracts. They do not certify a gameplay change.
